text:
SRE-Bot: 🔔 Paging on-call @Mike (on-call) — P1: Partial observability for tenant 'AureliaCorp' in dedicated VPC (eu-west-1). Missing traces and delayed logs reported by support. Impact: inability to trace API latency and a subset of request logs inaccessible. Please acknowledge and triage.

Mike (on-call): ack. On it. Can someone paste the customer-facing report?

Lina C.: Aurelia reported that between 12:03 and 12:25 UTC they see 30% of requests with 502s and our support can't find corresponding traces. They attached request IDs: r-9f3b2, r-9f3b3, r-9f3c1.

Alice M.: seeing similar on infra dashboards — their dedicated pool had a brief autoscaler event at ~12:05 then a rollback. Metrics ingestion for that tenant shows a lag spike.

Ben K.: ObsService, can you confirm which observability components are missing per-tenant?

ObsService: Automated alert — traces missing for tenant_id=aurelia_corp between 2025-11-18T12:02:00Z and 2025-11-18T12:28:00Z. Log-forwarder status: upstream-kafka-0 returned 503 for consumer group aurelia-logs-consumer for 1.2m. Metric partitions: partition 13 under-replicated for tenant shard mapping.

Raj P.: noted. Likely a transient broker-side routing hiccup during the autoscaler activity. If the forwarder couldn't commit offsets, logs would be delayed. Traces are in jaeger collector but looks like the tenant's trace-stream filter dropped batches 12:03-12:07.

Mike (on-call): assigning roles — Alice you run live mitigations on the forwarding layer, Raj look at trace ingestion config and get a quick hotfix if possible. Ben liaise with CS to scope customer impact messaging. Lina please hold Aurelia on call. I'll coordinate with infra.

Alice M.: running temporary bypass: enabling redundant forwarder path for aurelia-logs-consumer to kafka-broker-1. Command:
```
# enable redundant forwarder
curl -X POST https://infra-control/api/forwarders/route -d '{"tenant":"aurelia_corp","route":"kafka-broker-1","priority":10}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```
Applying now.

SRE-Bot: deploy-bot started rollout for forwarder route change (run id: fb-19724-3).

Ben K.: drafting a short customer note: "We're investigating partial observability in your VPC; engineers are implementing a bypass to restore logs and traces. We'll update in ~15m." Lina, join me after your call.

Lina C.: Aurelia on the line, they can confirm the 502s persist but are intermittent. They provided an internal trace-id: aeg-77b2. Can we check if that exists anywhere?

Raj P.: searching jaeger for aeg-77b2 — nothing returned in primary index. Querying backup span-store: found span batch with root trace aeg-77b2 but timestamp 12:04:09 and status "dropped_by_filter". Looks like tenant-specific sampling/filter rule misapplied during redeploy.

Mike (on-call): is that filter change from our side or from a tenant-config override?

Raj P.: appears to be a recent config we pushed for memory optimization on the dedicated pool (config ref: /configs/dedicated/aurelia/optimize-sample-v12). The timing matches the autoscaler event.

Alice M.: forwarder route change is active. Logs starting to replay into the backup pipeline — I can see a healthy offset commit now.

ObsService: log ingestion backlog for aurelia_corp decreasing. Current lag: 6m -> 30s. Traces: recoverable spans beginning to reappear in collector.

Mike (on-call): good. Raj, can we revert or patch the sampling rule to stop dropping spans?

Raj P.: applying immediate patch: update sampling config to ensure tenant override respected. Patch snippet: 
```
PATCH /configs/dedicated/aurelia/sampling
{ "rules": [{"id":"always-index-error","condition":"status>=500","action":"keep"}], "version":"v12.1-hotfix" }
```
Rolling now.

SRE-Bot: config-rollout started (roll id: cfg-19724-9).

Alice M.: replay job for logs kicked: job id replay-aurelia-19724. Watching progress: ~1.1k messages replayed, will continue until head.

Lina C.: Aurelia confirms they can see some of the missing logs now. They're still seeing two 502 spikes at 12:06 and 12:14. Asking if root cause will be fixed or just mitigation.

Ben K.: for customer comms — status update v1: "Mitigation in progress: redundant forwarder enabled and sampling rule patched. We are replaying logs and traces; visibility should be restored to near-real time in ~10–20 minutes. We are continuing to investigate root cause tied to autoscaler interaction with our per-tenant sampling optimization."

Raj P.: tracing patches completed and verified. Found that during scale-down we temporarily removed the tenant-specific config from the runtime configmap due to a race in rollout ordering. Implementing ordering fix to ensure configmap updates are applied before scale actions. I'll open an RFC/PR and a follow-up runbook.

Mike (on-call): excellent. Add a temporary guard to prevent scale events for this tenant until we push the ordering fix. Alice, keep replay until backlog is zero.

Alice M.: guard applied: set cluster annotation prevent-scale:aurelia=true. Replay job shows backlog 250 -> 0 in last 4m.

ObsService: monitoring shows traces now consistently indexed; metric partition 13 replication stabilized. No new under-replicated partitions reported in last 5m.

Lina C.: sharing initial impact summary with Aurelia: partial loss of tracing and delayed logs for ~25 minutes; possible request retries caused 502s; mitigation applied and visibility restored, full RCA and timeline to follow. They asked for export of missing traces and logs for audit — Ben coordinating.

Ben K.: will request an expunge/export job. Command to request export:
```
POST /ops/export?tenant=aurelia_corp&from=2025-11-18T12:00:00Z&to=2025-11-18T12:30:00Z&artifact=logs,traces
```
Submitting now.

SRE-Bot: export job submitted (export-id: exp-19724-55). Estimated prep time 12 min.

Mike (on-call): moving to bridge follow-through. On-call handover in 30m to night SRE. Raj, please attach the config PR and rollback test to the incident ticket. Alice keep replay until export completes. Ben/Lina continue customer comms. I'll update status page with mitigations.

Raj P.: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/configs/pull/5423 — includes fix and unit tests for rollout ordering. Adding runbook excerpt: "if tenant config missing after scale event: verify configmap version -> pause scaler -> reapply config -> resume scaler."

Alice M.: export complete; logs/traces package available at s3://redwood-exports/aurelia/exp-19724-55.tar.gz. Backlog cleared. Removing prevent-scale guard and scheduling controlled scale test for 01:00 UTC.

ObsService: final checks: traces retention intact; trace sampling metrics restored to baseline. No residual ingestion errors.

Mike (on-call): closing active mitigation. Next steps: formal RCA in postmortem, customer-facing timeline, and change to autoscaler rollout ordering. If anyone sees regressions reopen thread. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Lina C.: confirming Aurelia is satisfied with immediate fix, appreciates prompt response. They'll wait for the RCA.

SRE-Bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Incident ticket: INC-19724.

Mike (on-call): handover note: oncall-night will monitor alerts; I'll leave the incident ticket in "awaiting RCA". Signing off from the bridge.

Ben K.: I'll draft the post-incident customer note and pair with the RCA timeline.

Alice M.: rolling log-forwarder orchestration change into canary to be monitored tomorrow.

Raj P.: tagging follow-ups: config PR, runbook updates, unit test to detect rollout-order race, add alert for per-tenant config drift during scale events.

ObsService: automated follow-up scheduled: health check re-run in 2h.

SRE-Bot: This thread closed for now. If needed, re-open by replying with `reopen`.
